b1-15.title: Online Shopping Deals
b1-15.story: Anna loves [[online shopping]], but she always looks for a good deal. Last night she found a nice jacket on a website for students. First she checked the [[price list]]: the jacket cost fifty dollars. Then Max sent her a [[promo code]] from his favorite store. With the code, she got a twenty percent [[discount]]. Anna did some quick math: fifty [[minus]] ten is forty. It is hard to find a [[balance]] between nice things and saving money. Anna bought the jacket and saved every [[penny]] of the rest for summer.

b1-16.title: A Walk Downtown
b1-16.story: On Saturday, Anna showed Sofia around [[downtown]] Kyiv. They walked along the main [[avenue]] and stopped near a tall [[monument]]. A friendly [[guide]] was telling a group about the city's history. Sofia listened and decided to join a [[city tour]] next weekend. At a [[kiosk]], the girls bought cold water and two ice creams. Behind it, a long wall was covered with bright [[graffiti]]. Then they found a small shop full of old clocks and lamps. Sofia loved an [[antique]], a tiny silver box, but it was too expensive. So she bought a cheap magnet as a [[souvenir]] instead. That evening, she put it on her fridge and smiled.

b1-17.title: A Day at the Spa
b1-17.story: Anna's mama had a busy month, so Anna planned a special day for her. In the morning, they went to a [[beauty salon]] near their home. A woman did their hair and put on some light [[makeup]]. After lunch, they visited a [[spa center]] with a warm pool. There was also a short [[yoga]] class, and Mama tried it for the first time. She wore soft clothes because [[comfort]] was more important than style today. At home, Dad paid her a [[compliment]]: "You look so relaxed and happy!" Mama laughed and said it was the best gift ever.

b1-18.title: Getting Around the City
b1-18.story: Anna and Taras were going to visit their grandparents in a village near Kyiv. First, they took the [[metro]] from their home to the city center. Public [[transport]] is cheap, but it was very crowded that morning. Then they changed to a [[trolleybus]] that went to the bus station. From there, a [[minibus]] usually goes to the village. But today it was full, so Dad picked them up in the family [[minivan]]. On the way, they saw a white [[limousine]] with flowers for a wedding. Near the village, Dad turned on the [[GPS]], but it showed a road through a field. In the end, Grandpa met them in his old [[jeep]] and drove them home.

b1-19.title: At the Airport
b1-19.story: Last summer, Anna flew to Spain with her class for a language course. At home, she checked her [[passport]] three times. She didn't need a [[visa]], but she printed her hotel [[booking]] just in case. At the airport, the class found the right [[terminal]] and went to [[check-in]]. Anna's [[baggage]] was two kilos too heavy, so she put her shoes in her backpack. Near the gate, people with [[business class]] tickets got on the plane first. Through the window, Max pointed at a small private [[jet]]. He said it belonged to a team that jumps with [[parachutes|parachute]] at air shows. Anna laughed and said she was happy in her normal seat.

b1-20.title: A Hotel Stay
b1-20.story: Lisa and Ira were planning a summer trip to the sea. First, they visited a travel [[bureau]] in the city center. There, a friendly [[travel agent]] showed them many options. A beach [[resort]] was beautiful but much too expensive. A [[motel]] on the highway was cheap, but it was far from the beach. A [[hostel]] was cheaper still, but Ira wanted a quiet room. In the end, they chose a small family hotel near the beach. When they arrived, the woman at [[reception]] gave them the key and the [[Wi-Fi]] password. On the last morning, they ordered [[room service]] as a little treat. Breakfast was so good that they almost missed [[check-out]] at eleven.

b1-21.title: A Road Trip
b1-21.story: Last summer, Max and his dad went on a [[road trip]] to the mountains. On the second day, the car's [[motor]] started making a strange noise. They drove slowly, well below the speed [[limit]], to the next town. A local [[mechanic]] said he needed a [[minimum]] of three hours to fix it. His garage was small, with space for a [[maximum]] of two cars. While they waited, a friendly [[biker]] stopped and shared his sandwiches with them. Then there was a small [[incident]]: a goat walked into the garage! For five minutes, there was total [[chaos]] as everyone tried to catch it. Finally, the car was ready, and Max called it the best day of the trip.

b1-22.title: Backpacking in Australia
b1-22.story: After university, Max's sister Sofia went [[backpacking]] in Australia for a month. She stayed in hostels and met many other [[backpackers|backpacker]] from around the world. Sofia learned that [[tourism]] is very important for small towns there. In the north, she joined a two-day [[safari]] to see wild animals. In a forest park, she saw a sleepy [[koala]] high up in a tree. In the desert, she took a funny photo next to a huge [[cactus]]. One day she got lost, but an old [[compass]] helped her find the way back. In her last week, she went on a three-day [[voyage]] along the coast by boat. Back home, she told Max it was the best month of her life.
